d: Janjatiy gaurav divas ke avsar par kritagy rashtr dharti aaba bhagvan birsa munda ko naman kar raha hai. is avsar par pradhanmantri narendr modi ne maharashtr men aayojit karyakram ko sanbodhit kiya. vahin, jharkhand aaj apna 26van sthapna divas mana raha hai. is mauke par rashtrapti, pradhanmantri, rajyapal aur mukhyamantri ne rajyavasiyon ko shubhkamnaen din. sthapna divas ke avsar par svachchhata ka sandesh dene ke lie rajy ke sabhi jilon men ran phor klinlines ka aayojan kiya gaya. udhar, lok aastha aur sury upasna ke mahaparv chhath ko lekar pure rajy men bhaktimay mahaul hai. aaj…
